---
applyTo: "src/assets/i18n/**,translations/**"
---

# Translations

- In this repository, edit only Norwegian (`nb`) and English (`en`) translations under `src/assets/i18n`.
- Other languages are managed through Lokalise and arrive via pull requests; use the scripts under `translations/` only for their intended workflows.
- Run `npm run translations:sort` after adding or changing translation keys.
